note: A Chao1 count is not reported: every one of the 6000 sampled identities was unique (no repeats), so the space is >> 6000 but cannot be estimated from repeats; PACKING numbers are lower bounds limited by the pool size. Colour (palette, skin tone, hair colour) is excluded from every count: a palette swap is not a new person. Head/hair/facial hair/glasses carry most of the perceived identity (see the 50-character sheet); torso/limb silhouettes vary little (measured rendered-silhouette IoU mean 0.59), so 'body' contributes fewer real identities than its axes suggest.
